answer: An agent economy requires each identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before it can vote at its governance summit, with one vote per funded identity. A whisper of support cannot substitute for the deposit, and even a relic account from launch must pay. Creating 10,000 voting identities therefore immobilizes one million tokens for a month. The defense does not make fake names scarce; it makes the voting power behind them costly to acquire and maintain.
